Emergency batch

Every generated QuickStatement, in run order. Block 1 is the orphan-description labels and must run first; everything else follows. Paste one file at a time into QuickStatements — each is independent, so a run that dies loses only its own chunk.

One paste: ALL.txt — 10,000 lines drawn at random from the 48,169 in the corpus (1,022 of them orphan labels), in run order. 0.73 MB. Sized to what QuickStatements actually accepts in one paste; regenerate for a different draw. The per-file chunks below still hold every line.

48,169 lines total: 5,066 orphan labels, then 43,103 across 68 files. Generated 2026-10-05 18:45 UTC.

Block 1 — orphan-description labels

These items each carry a description with no label in that language. On Wikidata the uniqueness constraint is on the (label, description) pair, so a description with no label stakes the half that matters least and can get the eventual label edit rejected — a description with no label costs a label. The standing remedy deletes the description; here we add the label and keep it, which is possible for 97% of them. That is why this block is first. Per language: uk 2,640 id 2,146 nl 91 fr 17 de 12 ar 9 zh 6 ru 6 es 5 vi 5 ms 5 ca 4 he 4 zh-hant 4 zh-hans 4 tr 4 pt 4 hu 4 hr 4 gl 4 el 4 da 4 bn 4 zh-tw 3 zh-sg 3 zh-cn 3 pl 3 sv 3 ro 3 nb 3 min 3 fa 3 eu 3 cs 3 ast 3 fi 3 sl 3 nn 3 jv 2 zh-hk 2 pa 2 mr 2 ko 2 hi 2 as 2 eo 2 zh-mo 2 it 2 az 1
